name: tokenwise
description: Spends tokens where the work needs them: sizes each request, sets model and effort to match, escalates when a result has to be redone, and offers a clean start when a new task arrives on a heavy context. English and Italian.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the questions and of the classifier's instructions. auto follows the language Claude Code is set to.

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: The model that sizes each request. sonnet is more accurate; haiku costs about a twentieth and answers faster.

freshStart.title: Offer a clean start above
freshStart.description: Context size above which a new task, or a return after an hour away, brings the offer to clear or compact before sending the request. off never offers it.

profile.title: Your work and tools
profile.description: Optional. A few lines about your work, sent to the classifier with every request so it weighs them better. For example: I build Laravel apps and deploy on Coolify; anything touching production or client data is serious work. At most 1,000 characters.
